component.name: YACCGL
component.summary: Install Aniimo and add it to Steam

developer.name: Yet Another Creature Collector Game Launcher contributors

description.p: An unofficial installer for the standalone PC version of Aniimo, made for the Steam Deck and other Linux PCs.

ul.li: Downloads the game from its official servers and keeps it up to date
Lets you choose where to install it, including SD cards
Adds it to Steam as a non-Steam game with Proton 10 and Steam Input disabled
Adds the game's official library artwork

description.p: This project is not affiliated with Pawprint Interactive, FunPlus or Valve.
Add to Steam turns off Steam Input for Aniimo automatically, so the controller reaches the game without a manual Properties change.
Preferences → Check for updates installs a newer Flatpak in place from GitHub Releases (no uninstall).
Log In opens FunPlus's login dialog directly (via FPX.dll) instead of the full game, still using the Steam Proton prefix so the session carries over to Game Mode.
Single-window mode is off by default again, including for installs where 0.1.5 turned it on.

Fixes not being able to type in Aniimo's login window in Game Mode. A new Log In button opens the game in Desktop Mode so you can log in once, and single-window mode (on by default) keeps the login window inside the game so the on-screen keyboard works.
Game downloads are only accepted over HTTPS. Removed the Play button: launch Aniimo from your Steam library.
A shorter main window that fits the Steam Deck screen: a Game section and a Steam section, with the Steam account, Proton version, artwork, launch options and Repair moved to Preferences.

Fixes the game saying there isn't enough free space (about 7 GB) on the Steam Deck. The install folder now gets its own drive letter in the game's Proton prefix, so the game checks the right disk. Existing installs are fixed the next time the launcher is opened.
Fixes the Steam shortcut sometimes not appearing: Steam is now reliably detected and closed before its files are changed, and the shortcut is checked again after Steam restarts.
